title: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text:
Breese Pitt Dixon careers page (read 4 Oct 2026 AEDT): We don't advertise individual vacancies here. If you'd like to explore a career with Breese Pitt Dixon, email us an introduction with your CV and a short note on the kind of work you're looking for. Email your expression of interest to info@bpd.com.au.
Who We're Looking For: Graduate and experienced civil engineers; Survey Assistants, Technicians, Draftspersons, Graduate and Licensed Surveyors; Town planners and urban designers; Construction, contract and project management professionals. Even if we're not recruiting in your discipline right now, we'd still like to hear from you.
Work: designing major estates and critical infrastructure such as wetlands, retarding basins, trunk sewers, drainage and roads; civil engineering, design and construction; land surveying; planning and urban design.
Office: 1/19 Cato Street Hawthorn East VIC 3123. Phone +61 3 8823 2300.
apply_instructions: Email EOI with CV to info@bpd.com.au (published on careers page as the application inbox).
